description: This Java class defines the OrderAccountProduct entity, which models the linkage between an order account and an order product, including various date fields and status indicators, within the sales management system.

classes.name: OrderAccountProduct
classes.description: Entity class representing the association between an order account and a product, including tracking dates and statuses.

methods.name: getOrderAccountProductId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of this OrderAccountProduct.

methods.name: setOrderAccountProductId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this OrderAccountProduct.

methods.name: getOrderAccount
methods.description: Retrieves the associated OrderAccount.

methods.name: setOrderAccount
methods.description: Associates this OrderAccountProduct with a specific OrderAccount.

methods.name: getOrderProduct
methods.description: Retrieves the associated OrderProduct.

methods.name: setOrderProduct
methods.description: Associates this OrderAccountProduct with a specific OrderProduct.

methods.name: getOrderAccountProductStartDate
methods.description: Gets the start date of the order account product period.

methods.name: setOrderAccountProductStartDate
methods.description: Sets the start date for the order account product period.

methods.name: getOrderAccountProductEndDate
methods.description: Gets the end date of the order account product period.

methods.name: setOrderAccountProductEndDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the order account product period.

methods.name: getOrderAccountProductEot
methods.description: Gets the end of term timestamp for this product.

methods.name: setOrderAccountProductEot
methods.description: Sets the end of term timestamp for this product.

methods.name: getOrderAccountProductAccountedDate
methods.description: Retrieves the date when the product was accounted.

methods.name: setOrderAccountProductAccountedDate
methods.description: Sets the date when the product was accounted.

methods.name: getOrderAccountProductLastStatusDate
methods.description: Retrieves the last status change date.

methods.name: setOrderAccountProductLastStatusDate
methods.description: Sets the last status change date.

methods.name: getOrderAccountProductLastTransactionStatus
methods.description: Gets the status of the last transaction.

methods.name: setOrderAccountProductLastTransactionStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the last transaction.

methods.name: getOrderAccountProductPaymentFrequencyType
methods.description: Gets the payment frequency type for this product.

methods.name: setOrderAccountProductPaymentFrequencyType
methods.description: Sets the payment frequency type for this product.

methods.name: getOrderAccountProductStatus
methods.description: Gets the current status of the order account product.

methods.name: setOrderAccountProductStatus
methods.description: Sets the current status of the order account product.
